events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary actor and comedian John Cleese, known for his work with Monty Python and 'Fawlty Towers', celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: From silly walks to hotel mayhem, John Cleese has given us decades of iconic comedy. Raising a glass to the master on his 87th!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, experimental 'White Album'. Still a masterpiece, still dividing opinion.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost one of music's most electrifying performers. Freddie Mercury's legacy continues to rock the world.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', in 1965.

angles.name: Folk-Rock Evolution
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since The Beatles pushed boundaries with 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that set the stage for so much more.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles co-founder John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, John Lennon's message of peace and his timeless music resonate as strongly as ever. A true icon, never forgotten.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music icon David Bowie, who passed away in 2016, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. Forever changing music, fashion, and art.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we celebrate the enduring legend of Elvis Presley. His music still shakes the world.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock and roll history. What's your favourite Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer Sir Rod Stewart, known for hits like 'Maggie May' and 'Sailing', celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Heart
angles.copy: Still rocking and looking good at 82! Happy birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart. What's your go-to Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Nutty Boy's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th to Suggs, the voice of Madness! Still bringing the house down with those classic tracks.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer Paul Young, famous for his soulful voice and 80s hits, celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Soulful Seventies
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! His voice defined the 80s for so many of us. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend, songwriter, and businesswoman Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon whose talent and heart shine brighter than rhinestones.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That's Leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting legend, he's done it all.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British R&B and soul singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean King of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to Billy Ocean! Still getting outta our dreams and into our cars with those timeless tunes.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame first induction
events.blurb: The first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held in 1989, honouring pioneers like The Beatles, Elvis Presley, and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Birth of a Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years since the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame first opened its doors to music's greats. Who was in that inaugural class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Still charming audiences after all these years with Take That.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles performed their iconic and final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Get Back to the Roof
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning musician, singer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo superstardom, his hits are timeless.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: Rom-Com Royalty
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the eternally charming Hugh Grant! Still the king of the British rom-com.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Prince
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to JT! From *NSYNC to solo superstardom, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure Sir David Jason, acclaimed for his roles as Del Boy and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Only Fools & Legends
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable Sir David Jason! A true British institution who has given us so many unforgettable characters.

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: A Tragic Loss
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, music lost three bright stars: Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their legacy lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s hits and viral fame, celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! Still 'Never Gonna Give You Up' on those classic tunes.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley, who passed away in 1981, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 82nd birthday, we remember the iconic Bob Marley. His message of unity and his music are eternal.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Carole King, known for her influential album 'Tapestry', celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Talent
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the legendary Carole King! A songwriting powerhouse whose music continues to touch generations.
